title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Devops Engineer role at Rain

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 2.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus.

We've raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history—and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer to join our innovative and fast-paced team.

This role offers the opportunity to design, deploy, and manage scalable, cloud-native infrastructure to support modern applications.

As a DevOps Engineer, you will work with cutting-edge tools and technologies, ensuring seamless integration and deployment for our microservices architecture. If you thrive in environments focused on automation, scalability, and observability, this is the perfect role for you!

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Infrastructure Automation: Design and implement infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and Terragrunt. Automate provisioning and deployment of AWS resources to ensure high availability and scalability.
  2. Microservices Deployment: Build and manage containerized applications using Kubernetes with Helm for package management. Support and enhance microservices developed in Go (Golang).
  3. CI/CD Pipelines: Develop and maintain robust pipelines in GitLab CI/CD to enable seamless build, test, and deployment workflows. Optimize pipelines for performance, reliability, and security.
  4. Monitoring and Observability: Set up and maintain observability stacks using tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog. Monitor system health and performance, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
  5. Collaboration and Support: Collaborate with development and QA teams to ensure efficient application lifecycle management. Document processes, workflows, and playbooks for effective knowledge sharing.

Required Skills and Experience:

  1. Proven experience with Kubernetes in production environments, including deploying and scaling applications.
  2. Strong expertise in Terraform and Terragrunt for IaC.
  3. Hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD for building and managing pipelines.
  4. Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
  5. Experience with monitoring and observability tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog.
  6. Familiarity with configuration management tools (e.g., Helm) and secure application deployment practices.
  7. Public Cloud provider certifications in AWS & or Kubernetes (nice-to-have).

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  1. Experience with SRE practices and incident management workflows.
  2. Proficiency in developing and deploying microservices, especially with Go (Golang).
  3. Familiarity with multi-environment infrastructure setups and best practices.
  4. Knowledge of database systems like PostgreSQL.
  5. Experience with load balancing and auto-scaling in cloud-native environments.

Senior Finance Manager, Manufacturing & Material

About Whirlpool Corporation
Whirlpool Corporation (NYSE: WHR) is a leading kitchen and laundry appliance company, in constant pursuit of improving life at home and inspiring generations with our brands. The company is driving meaningful innovation to meet the evolving needs of consumers through its iconic brand portfolio, including Whirlpool, KitchenAid, JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul, and InSinkErator. In 2023, the company reported approximately $19 billion in annual sales, 59,000 employees, and 55 manufacturing and technology research centers. Additional information about the company can be found at WhirlpoolCorp.com.

Requisition ID: 67744
About Whirlpool Corporation
Whirlpool Corporation (NYSE: WHR) is a leading kitchen and laundry appliance company, in constant pursuit of improving life at home and inspiring generations with our brands. The company is driving meaningful innovation to meet the evolving needs of consumers through its iconic brand portfolio, including Whirlpool, KitchenAid, JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul, and InSinkErator. In 2023, the company reported approximately $19 billion in annual sales, 59,000 employees, and 55 manufacturing and technology research centers. Additional information about the company can be found at WhirlpoolCorp.com.
The team you will be a part of
The Finance General team manages the planning and direction of finance process and activities. Activities include the efficient operation and cost-effectiveness of operating systems and programs.
This Role In Summary
We are seeking a highly results-driven and strategically-minded Senior Finance Manager to join our team. This pivotal role will be instrumental in driving significant cost reduction initiatives related to material management (including Bill of Materials) and manufacturing costs, with a specific focus on our operations in Brazil and Argentina . The successful candidate will provide robust financial leadership, strategic insights , and in-depth analysis to optimize the financial performance of our end-to-end operations, working closely with and providing support to senior leadership to achieve substantial financial improvements and contribute to long-term business strategy.
Furthermore, this role will play a critical part in ensuring robust financial controls and compliance, including Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements . The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of both finance and manufacturing processes, a keen eye for identifying and capitalizing on cost savings opportunities, and the ability to partner effectively across functions.
Your Responsibilities Will Include
Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) for:

  • Develop and manage financial forecasts, budgets, and long-range plans specifically for raw material procurement and manufacturing operations within Brazil and Argentina.
  • Conduct in-depth variance analysis, identifying key drivers of cost fluctuations, with a particular emphasis on material and production costs, and recommend actionable corrective measures.
  • Prepare comprehensive financial reports and presentations for senior management, highlighting performance trends, cost reduction achievements, risks, and opportunities.
Material (BOM) & Manufacturing Cost Reduction
  • Lead financial analysis of Bill of Materials (BOM) to identify opportunities for material cost reduction through design optimization, supplier negotiations, alternative sourcing, and standardization for operations in Brazil and Argentina.
  • Partner closely with manufacturing operations, engineering, and procurement in Brazil and Argentina to analyze production processes, identify cost drivers, and implement financial controls to reduce labor, overhead, waste, and rework costs.
  • Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to material costs, manufacturing efficiency, and overall cost reduction targets.
  • Evaluate the financial impact of process improvements, automation initiatives, and technology investments within manufacturing.
Strategic Business Partnering
  • Act as a key financial business partner to manufacturing and procurement leadership, providing critical financial insights and guidance on strategic initiatives, capital expenditures, and operational improvements relevant to the Brazil and Argentina markets.
  • Evaluate the financial viability of new projects and product launches, focusing on cost-benefit analysis.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to align financial goals with operational execution and drive a culture of cost consciousness.
Process Improvement & Compliance
  • Identify and implement improvements to financial processes, systems, and reporting within the Bill of Materials and Manufacturing.
  • Design, implement, and monitor robust internal controls over financial reporting (including SOX compliance) related to Materials and Manufacturing activities.
  • Ensure strict compliance with internal controls, accounting policies, and external financial regulations.
  • Lead or participate in internal and external audits, specifically addressing SOX and other regulatory requirements.
Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering or a related quantitative field.
  • 10 years+ of progressive experience in finance roles, operations finance, or manufacturing finance.
  • Demonstrated expertise in cost accounting, financial analysis, and modeling within a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong understanding of Bill of Materials (BOM) structures, raw material costing, and manufacturing processes.
  • Proven track record of identifying and driving significant cost reduction initiatives.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
  • Proven Leadership skills, building and nurturing high-performing teams through talent identification, fostering positive environments, coaching and motivating individuals to ensure growth and career progression, as well as delegation and conflict management skills to foster a collaborative atmosphere.
  • English advanced / fluent.
Preferred Skills And Experiences
  • Master's degree (MBA) or professional certification (CRC, CPA, CMA).
  • Experience in a high-volume, complex manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic setting.
  • Proactive approach to identifying and resolving financial and operational challenges.
  • Advanced proficiency in Data Analytics, Data Lake and Microsoft Excel (including complex financial modeling) and financial reporting tools.
  • Experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) and business intelligence platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
What We Offer
  • Flexible schedule;
  • "No dress code";
  • Gympass;
  • Transportation voucher,
  • Shuttle buses or Free on-site parking;
  • Food voucher;
  • Meal on-site;
  • Benefits such as payment-deducted or social loans, health plan, dental plan, life insurance, and private pension plan compatible with the market;
  • Annual Executive Check-Up covered by the Health Plan, with no co-payment;
  • Employee Support Program, with 24-hour assistance from legal, social, financial, social workers, and psychologists;
  • Daycare allowance or Nursery at the company;
  • Services available on-site: beauty and aesthetics salon, in-house bank, laundry, cafeteria, restaurant, and lactation room;
  • Two weeks of remote work per year;
  • After 5 years with the company, eligible employees can take four weeks of paid leave;
  • Executive discount on products through Compra Certa;
  • Discounts on insurance (pet, auto, home, bike, travel, and more);
  • Extended maternity/paternity leave.

Estamos sempre em busca de talentos únicos para somar e fazer parte do nosso time. Profissionais apaixonados pelo que fazem e que se identifiquem com o que acreditamos. Reimaginamos a Saúde Animal e vamos além.
Somos a Ourofino e a Ourofino é cada um de nós.

description:
Coordenador de DTM (Desenvolvimento Técnico de Mercado) - SC/RS

Ubyfol Passo Fundo, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil

Coordenador de DTM (Desenvolvimento Técnico de Mercado) - SC/RS

Ubyfol Passo Fundo, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil

Ser UbyAgro é fazer parte de uma super equipe que ama o que faz! Um time focado em ser presente, solucionando os desafios do agricultor de forma simples e autêntica . Temos orgulho da nossa história de quem somos e de como fazemos!
O que move nossa alma é fazer a diferença como empresa parceira do agricultor brasileiro, caminhando ao seu lado no desafio de aumentar a produtividade com sustentabilidade no campo. Tudo isso pautado sobre nossos Valores promovendo um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o protagonismo , a inovação, a diversidade , a colaboração e a meritocracia .
Nosso time de Qualidade busca uma pessoa apaixonada pela área e em levar soluções de alta qualidade para clientes interno e externo, contribuindo para alavancar a produtividade e sustentabilidade na agricultura.
Na posição de Coordenador de DTM (Desenvolvimento Técnico de Mercado) você atuará nos estados de Santa Catarina e Rio Grande do Sul e será responsável por coordenar iniciativas de pesquisa e desenvolvimento junto aos parceiros da empresa, validando agronomicamente novos produtos e consolidando os resultados obtidos em protocolos e Farm Tests. Você irá oferecer suporte técnico para a equipe comercial da região de atuação, conduzindo ações de capacitação, geração de demanda e gestão de bonificações. Promoverá relacionamento com influenciadores estratégicos, participará de eventos técnicos, identificará tendências de mercado, apoiará a liderança na gestão da equipe, clima organizacional e indicadores de desempenho e realizará a gestão do SAC na área de atuação.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Nessa posição você será responsável por:

  • Coordenar projetos de pesquisa (com foco em produtos biológicos e soluções nutricionais) junto a instituições e consultorias parceiras;
  • Validar em áreas comerciais a eficiência agronômica de novos produtos e consolidar os resultados de protocolos de Farm Test (produtos bonificados);
  • Suportar a equipe comercial nas ações de geração de demanda (Palestras, Dias de Campo, Feiras, Blitz, etc.) e na capacitação técnica;
  • Identificar e prospectar parcerias com influenciadores e instituições de pesquisa na região de atuação, coordenando ações conjuntas e promovendo relacionamento estratégico;
  • Acompanhar visitas estratégicas a clientes in loco, junto com a equipe comercial;
  • Participar de eventos técnicos e científicos estratégicos (simpósios, workshops, congressos), visando identificar tendências e inovações do mercado;
  • Identificar tendências de mercado e oportunidades para ampliação do portfólio de produtos;
  • Liderar a implementação de treinamentos de capacitação técnica junto às regionais;
  • Identificar os principais concorrentes na região, bem como suas estratégias de acesso ao mercado;
  • Liderar a equipe sob sua responsabilidade, acompanhando indicadores de performance, metas do setor, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional e a manutenção de um clima organizacional positivo.

Requisitos e qualificações
Para ter sucesso nessa posição é importante:
Necessário
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Agronômica;
  • Conhecimento em Nutrição de Plantas, Fisiologia Vegetal, Fertilidade do Solo, Manejo e tratos culturais;
  • Vivência nas culturas de Soja, Arroz, Trigo, HF e/ou outras da região.

Desejável
  • Pós Graduação e/ou o Mestrado em Nutrição de plantas ou Proteção de Plantas;
  • Vivência cem cargo de Desenvolvimento de Mercado ou Pesquisa;
  • Conhecimento em Inglês e Espanhol Intermediário;
  • Disponibilidade para residir em Passo Fundo/RS e/ou outras da região.

Informações adicionais

  • Nutrir um espírito visionário;
  • Valorizar as pessoas;
  • Cultivar a Integridade;
  • Garantir excelência dos nossos produtos e serviços;
  • Desenvolver inovações relevantes para nossa cultura;
  • Botina Amarela (Identificar-se com o campo da cabeça aos pés);

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 2.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus.

We've raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history—and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer to join our innovative and fast-paced team.

This role offers the opportunity to design, deploy, and manage scalable, cloud-native infrastructure to support modern applications.

As a DevOps Engineer, you will work with cutting-edge tools and technologies, ensuring seamless integration and deployment for our microservices architecture. If you thrive in environments focused on automation, scalability, and observability, this is the perfect role for you!

  5. Collaboration and Support: Collaborate with development and QA teams to ensure efficient application lifecycle management. Document processes, workflows, and playbooks for effective knowledge sharing.

  • Familiarity with configuration management tools (e.g., Helm) and secure application deployment practices.

  • Pensamos antes de fazer. Acreditamos que a organização é a base para eficiência, qualidade e segurança em tudo que fazemos.

  • Somos próximos e nos ajudamos. O respeito às pessoas é um valor fundamental que norteia todas as nossas relações, tanto internas quanto externas. Acreditamos que o respeito é a base para um ambiente de trabalho positivo e produtivo, onde todas as pessoas podem dar o seu melhor.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Com uma forte capacidade de organização, visão sistêmica e senso de urgência, você irá:

  • Liderar tecnicamente e gerencialmente projetos de engenharia civil em ambientes industriais.

  • Garantir o acompanhamento e controle dos cronogramas, custos, riscos e entregas, mantendo o alinhamento com os objetivos contratuais e expectativas do cliente.
  • Analisar problemas com visão crítica e propor soluções práticas e sustentáveis, sendo agente ativo na resolução de desafios.
  • Reportar com consistência e clareza os marcos do projeto, promovendo transparência na comunicação, bem como emitir relatório técnicos.
  • Estruturar, coordenar e otimizar processos e fluxos de trabalho, assegurando padrões de segurança, qualidade e eficiência.
  • Liderar e desenvolver equipes operacionais, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo, produtivo e alinhado à cultura da empresa.
  • Atuar com senso de propriedade, antecipando riscos e oportunidades que impactem o sucesso dos projetos.
  • Analisar financeira do projeto, garantindo a sua sustentabilidade através da otimização dos recursos.
  • Implementar práticas de melhoria contínua, buscando ganhos de produtividade e eficiência operacional ao longo das fases do projeto.

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada atuando como Pessoa Engenheira Civil em ambientes industriais.

  • Forte capacidade de leitura de cenário e atuação com foco em solução.

Our organisation

At DLL, we are many things. We are team members, family members, and community members. We are members of society, with different cultures and nationalities. Members of change. Each of us has different beliefs, passions, points of view, talents, and interests. We have diverse backgrounds, cultures, nationalities, and histories. Our company was founded in the Netherlands. Today, we are a truly multinational company. Our unique culture is rooted in greater collaboration, less hierarchy, and honest candor that allows us to integrate, ideate, and innovate across borders. Many companies claim to be European, American, Asian, or Australian, but at DLL, we are all those places and more.

We are an intercultural collaboration—a connected network—that comes together every day with one goal in mind: Partnership for a better world!

Your function

As a Senior Risk Analyst , you will be responsible for monitoring and ensuring the consistent implementation and compliance of regulatory requirements under the CRO scope. The role involves reviewing documentation, operating practices, and procedures across the organization.

  • Interpret laws and regulations of regulatory bodies;
  • Manage current banking legislation and monitor updates;
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements under the CRO scope;
  • Support and train other departments on regulation matters;
  • Interact with regulatory bodies;
  • Maintain all requirements related to banking certifications.

Your profile

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, or related field;
  • Solid knowledge of regulations applicable to banking institutions and financial markets;
  • Professional experience with banking legislation;
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken;
  • Highly adaptable to changing environments;

We offer

A Movida é uma empresa de soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana e modelo de negócios com forte direcionamento para desenvolvimento socioambiental. Desde 2006 no mercado, conta hoje com a frota mais nova do Brasil e dispõe de lojas nas principais cidades e aeroportos do país. title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Devops Engineer role at Rain .

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 2.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus.

We've raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history—and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer to join our innovative and fast-paced team.

This role offers the opportunity to design, deploy, and manage scalable, cloud-native infrastructure to support modern applications.

As a DevOps Engineer, you will work with cutting-edge tools and technologies, ensuring seamless integration and deployment for our microservices architecture. If you thrive in environments focused on automation, scalability, and observability, this is the perfect role for you!

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Infrastructure Automation: Design and implement infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and Terragrunt. Automate provisioning and deployment of AWS resources to ensure high availability and scalability.

  4. Monitoring and Observability: Set up and maintain observability stacks using tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog. Monitor system health and performance, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
  5. Collaboration and Support: Collaborate with development and QA teams to ensure efficient application lifecycle management. Document processes, workflows, and playbooks for effective knowledge sharing.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Proven experience with Kubernetes in production environments, including deploying and scaling applications.
  • Strong expertise in Terraform and Terragrunt for IaC.
  • Hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD for building and managing pipelines.
  • Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog.
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools (e.g., Helm) and secure application deployment practices.
  • Public Cloud provider certifications in AWS & or Kubernetes (Nice-to-Have).

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience with SRE practices and incident management workflows.
  • Proficiency in developing and deploying microservices, especially with Go (Golang).
  • Familiarity with multi-environment infrastructure setups and best practices.
  • Knowledge of database systems like PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with load balancing and auto-scaling in cloud-native environments.

Job Overview:

Responsibilities
Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Conduct precise and comprehensive land and marine surveys, ensuring adherence to industry standards and regulations
  • Lead and oversee all survey activities within the EPCI (Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Installation) projects, providing expert guidance and support to the project team
  • Utilize advanced surveying equipment, software, and techniques to accurately collect and analyze marine and land survey data, including bathymetry, geophysical data, and subsea infrastructure
  • Collaborate closely with project managers, engineers, and clients to define survey requirements, objectives, and deliverables for each project phase
  • Plan, organize, and execute survey operations, such as pre-installation surveys, subsea positioning, route surveys, and as-laid/as-built surveys while ensuring compliance with project specifications
  • Manage and interpret survey data and prepare detailed reports, charts, and visual representations, highlighting findings, anomalies, and potential obstacles
  • Conduct quality control checks on all survey data, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and integrity throughout the project lifecycle
  • Develop and maintain survey documentation, and survey equipment readiness, manage and coordinate survey-related contractors or business partners
  • Abreast with the latest advancements in land and marine survey technologies, methodologies, and regulations, and propose innovative solutions to enhance efficiency and accuracy
  • Mentor and train junior survey team members, fostering their professional growth and ensuring adherence to best practices and safety protocols
  • To be based at worksite based on project requirements, onshore and/or offshore
Qualifications
Essential Qualifications and Education:
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Land or Hydrography Survey, Marine Science, Geomatics, or a related field
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in land and marine surveying within the EPCI industry, with a proven track record of successfully delivering complex projects
  • Strong knowledge of relevant industry regulations, standards, and guidelines e.g., IMCA and/or International Hydrographic Organization (IHO) standards, Marine Spatial Planning (MSP), and Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) practices
  • Proficient in using industry-standard survey equipment and software, including GPS, GNSS, Single/Multibeam Echosounders, various survey sensors, geophysical survey equipment, and new tech photogrammetry and scanning surveying techniques
  • Familiar with Mapping software like AutoCAD, Global Mapper, GIS, tidal and bathymetry software
  • In-depth knowledge of land marine survey methodologies using ROVs and Installation Vessels, data processing, and quality/safety control techniques
  • Strong understanding of subsea infrastructure, offshore construction, and installation processes
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, clients, and stakeholders
  • Detail-oriented and analytical mindset, with a high level of accuracy and precision in survey data analysis and reporting
  • Up-to-date certifications in relevant surveying technologies (e.g., Land and Hydrographic Surveying, Subsea Positioning) are an added advantage
  • A proactive and curious attitude, continuously seeking improvement and innovation in land and marine survey practices
  • Ability to work in challenging onshore and offshore environments and adapt to variable working conditions and schedules

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

Proven ability to manage multiple customer priorities in parallel, while operating independently in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.
Detail-oriented and analytical, with a bias for action and a drive to resolve root causes, not just surface symptoms.

Collaborative, adaptable, and eager to work across teams, time zones, and cultures — with a proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership.

title: Sox Manager
description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprising global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world, promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses enable Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs connecting over 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans attending Live Nation events each year. For more information, visit .

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate, motivated, driven with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward-thinking, and committed. If these qualities describe you, please read on!

The Job

The SOX Manager ensures LBNE compliance with all internal System of Authority protocols, Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements, and documentation processes. Responsibilities include overseeing compliance activities, managing third-party verifications, coordinating the approval process, and supporting audits. The Manager acts as a liaison between departments and auditors, maintaining and reporting compliance standards effectively.

What This Role Will Do

SOX Compliance and Documentation:

  • Develop, implement, and oversee processes to ensure SOX adherence.
  • Maintain and update all SOX-related documentation, including controls and risk matrices.
  • Monitor compliance with the company's System of Authority protocols.

Third-Party Verifications:

  • Coordinate and oversee third-party compliance verifications.
  • Ensure timely completion and accurate record-keeping for audits.

Comp List Approval Process:

  • Manage and maintain the approval process, ensuring compliance with guidelines.
  • Resolve discrepancies or issues in workflows.

Audit Coordination:

  • Prepare for audits with internal teams, ensuring documentation readiness.
  • Serve as the main contact for external auditors.
  • Address findings and implement corrective actions.

Compliance Monitoring and Reporting:

  • Review compliance activities regularly to identify risks or gaps.
  • Generate and present detailed reports to leadership.

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Participate in cross-functional projects supporting company priorities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What This Person Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.
  • CPA, CIA, or CISA certification preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years in SOX compliance, controls, or auditing roles.
  • Experience with internal and external auditors.
  • Strong knowledge of SOX, COSO, and compliance best practices.

Required Skills:

  • Technical Expertise: Deep understanding of SOX, risk assessment, and compliance standards.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to evaluate complex processes and risks.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills for liaising with auditors and stakeholders.
  • Project Management: Strong organizational skills for managing multiple tasks and audits.
  • Detail-Oriented: Precision in documentation and reporting.
  • Problem-Solving: Proactive in addressing compliance issues.
  • Software Proficiency: Familiarity with audit software, ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle).
  • Language Skills: Full fluency in English.

Other Requirements:

  • Reside in São Paulo, Brazil. No relocation allowance provided.

Benefits & Perks

Our benefits are built around six pillars:

  • Health: Medical, vision, dental, mental health, FSA/HSA options.
  • Yourself: Free concert tickets, paid time off, holidays, sick leave, personal days.
  • Wealth: 401(k) with company match, stock reimbursement.
  • Family: Parental programs, caregiver leave, baby bonuses, fertility, adoption, surrogacy support.
  • Career: Development programs, tuition reimbursement, student loan assistance.
  • Others: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match.

Equal Employment Opportunity

We strive to reflect and support the diverse fans and artists we serve. We promote an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and contribute fully. We consider qualified applicants regardless of age, race, gender, disability, and other protected categories, and comply with applicable laws.

We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with local laws and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities or religious needs. Applicants should contact HR to request accommodations.

Hiring Practices

This job description outlines the general responsibilities and level of work. It is not exhaustive of all duties and qualifications. We aim to recruit the most qualified candidates efficiently and may use various channels for recruitment.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

Atendendo mais de 1.600 empresas, a Onfly se destaca por simplificar a reserva de passagens, hospedagens e reembolsos, eliminando burocracias e tornando a experiência mais ágil e eficiente. Sua abordagem une inovação e praticidade, garantindo mais transparência e produtividade para o mercado corporativo.

Além disso, a empresa já foi reconhecida por dois anos consecutivos pelo Great Place to Work, reforçando seu compromisso com um ambiente colaborativo e inovador.

Seu papel será entregar valor máximo aos futuros clientes durante o fechamento da compra.

Se você é movido(a) por desafios e inovação, essa vaga é para você!

  • The 360C People Experiences Operations role serves as a key facilitator in change management and stakeholder engagement for the 360C program, reporting directly to the 360 Careers Lead and supporting its deputies. This position is integral to tracking and enhancing stakeholder engagement initiatives, ensuring timely communication in collaboration with communications representatives, and assisting leadership in identifying early experience needs.

This will be achieved by cultivating a cohesive and integrated approach to stakeholder alignment and participant engagement approach that emphasizes participant experience while delivering effective business support. Responsibilities will include overseeing surveying and SharePoint management, maintaining FAQs, and managing the 360C support email to ensure coordinated responses with relevant team members and functions.
Essential Functions of the Job:
  • Serve as the primary change management and stakeholder engagement point of contact for the 360C program, ensuring effective communication and collaboration among all stakeholders.
  • Help define the vision and strategy for change, ensuring it is clear and compelling while collaborating with the 360C Leader and other stakeholders to ensure successful change implementation.
  • Own and maintain the Change Management Plan for the 360C program, aligning strategies with organizational goals and objectives.
  • Collaborate with the 360C Lead to support the identification and prioritization of early experience needs and improvement opportunities.
  • Effectively communicate change initiatives to all stakeholders, building support and buy-in while managing the communication timeline in partnership with communication representatives to ensure timely and effective messaging.
  • Identify and address potential resistance to change, providing support and guidance to stakeholders throughout the change process.
  • Oversee surveying processes, SharePoint management, and the maintenance of FAQs to support stakeholder inquiries and information dissemination.
  • Manage the 360C support email, coordinating responses with relevant team members and functions to ensure prompt and accurate communication.
  • Foster a positive and engaged participant experience during and after change initiatives by providing resources, training, and coaching to help employees adapt to changes.
  • Facilitate collaboration among enablement functions (e.g., Experience Management, Learning, Talent, and Recruiting), promoting a cohesive approach to stakeholder alignment and participant experience.
  • Continuously assess and improve change management processes to ensure effectiveness and drive continuous improvement in people experiences.
  • Analyze feedback and data from surveys to inform decision-making and identify areas for improvement in the change process and overall employee experience.
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:
  • Analyze stakeholder engagement metrics and feedback to identify trends and areas for improvement, making data-driven recommendations to enhance engagement strategies.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of change management initiatives by assessing employee feedback and survey results, using insights to inform future strategies and adjustments.
  • Review and interpret data from various sources, including surveys and performance metrics, to support informed decision-making regarding people experience enhancements and change processes.
  • Collaborate with 360C leadership to assess the impact of change initiatives on employee engagement and overall organizational performance, providing actionable insights to guide strategic planning and implementation.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements:
  • Strong understanding of change management methodologies, models, and best practices to effectively guide and support organizational change initiatives.
  • Proficiency in analyzing data and feedback to identify trends, inform decision-making, and drive continuous improvement in people experiences.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication abilities to convey change initiatives clearly and build support among stakeholders.
  • Strong relationship-building skills to foster collaboration and engagement with diverse stakeholders across the organization.
  • Capability to identify challenges related to change management and employee experience, developing effective solutions to address them.
  • Ability to understand and address the emotional needs of employees during change, ensuring their concerns are acknowledged and supported.
  • Experience with project management tools and techniques to organize and execute change initiatives effectively.
  • Familiarity with employee engagement strategies and best practices to enhance workplace culture during transitions.
  • Adaptability and resilience to navigate the complexities of change while maintaining focus on organizational goals.
  • Strong problem-solving skills to address issues proactively and facilitate smooth transitions during change initiatives.
Supervision Responsibilities:
Supervision Received:
  • Engage in regular communication with the 360 Careers Lead through weekly check-ins to discuss progress on change management initiatives and stakeholder engagement strategies, ensuring alignment on objectives and expectations.
  • Act independently in managing day-to-day responsibilities related to change management and stakeholder communication, while escalating significant issues or challenges to the 360 Careers Lead for guidance and resolution.
  • Consult with the 360 Careers Lead on strategic change initiatives and major project milestones, providing insights and recommendations to enhance stakeholder engagement and inform decision-making.
  • Seek feedback and provide regular updates to the 360 Careers Lead and its deputies regarding the effectiveness of communication strategies and stakeholder engagement efforts, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or a related field; a master’s degree or relevant certification (such as Change Management Certification, Prosci, or SHRM) is preferred but not required).
Experience:
  • Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in change management, stakeholder engagement, or organizational development within a medium-to-large environment.
  • Proven experience in implementing change initiatives, managing communication strategies, and fostering collaboration among diverse stakeholders is preferred.
Certification Requirements:
  • Relevant certifications in change management (such as Prosci Change Management Certification or Certified Change Management Professional), human resources (such as SHRM-CP or PHR), or organizational development are preferred.
  • Additional certifications in project management (such as PMP or CAPM) or data analytics may be beneficial but are not required.

Se você é analítico e busca otimizar processos, essa vaga é para você! Como Analista de Planejamento de Materiais, você garantirá o abastecimento e a produção eficientes, gerindo estoques, pedidos e fornecedores, além de monitorar indicadores e riscos. Faça a diferença na excelência operacional!

  • Monitorar e analisar o desempenho dos processos de fornecimento de materiais, identificando riscos e oportunidades.

  • Suportar as áreas de NPI, Planejamento de Demanda e Engenharia com a atualização de materiais.
  • Gestão de riscos: Identificar e mapear riscos de abastecimento da categoria e atendimento do MPS.
  • Atualização de relatórios e liberação de pedidos nacionais.
  • Preparar material e participar de reuniões.
  • Buscar melhorias continua nos processos.

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia de Produção, Administração ou áreas afins.

  • Governance and Continuous Improvement: Develop and maintain data governance standards to ensure data compliance, security, and scalability.

What you'll need:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Systems Development Analysis or similar;
  • Advanced English;
  • Proven experience in Data Operations, DevOps, or Data Engineering with a focus on operating and automating data pipelines.
  • Knowledge of monitoring and observability (e.g., tools like Datadog, New Relic, or Grafana) and test automation practices.
  • Experience with on-call processes and high-availability systems.
  • Team management skills, with a track record of leading automation and process improvement projects.
  • Strong knowledge of DataOps and DevOps for data, as well as CI/CD best practices applied to data pipelines.

Soft Skills:

  • Effective and transparent communication with other areas and colleagues;

  • Ability to meet deadlines and maintain high quality in work delivered;
  • Strong interpersonal skills to present cases and discuss them with involved areas;
  • Independence in task execution and proactivity in finding solutions;
  • Ability to work as part of a team, fostering a good relationship and collaboration with the team.

Differentials:

  • Certifications in DevOps or cloud platforms (such as Azure) are a plus.

More about you:

title: Mechanical Designer-Turbomachinery
description:
Join to apply for the Mechanical Designer-Turbomachinery role at Air Products

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Mechanical Designer-Turbomachinery role at Air Products

At Air Products, our purpose is to bring people together to reimagine what’s possible, collaborate and innovate solutions to the world’s most significant energy and environmental sustainability challenges. Grow with us as we embark on building tomorrow together by being the safest, most diverse and most profitable industrial gas company in the world.
Reimagine What’s Possible
Are you looking for a dynamic, growth-oriented career working with extraordinary people with a mission to provide world-class products and customer service? Rotoflow , An Air Products Business, may be the place for you!
Rotoflow is a full-service turbomachinery OEM providing a comprehensive range of new equipment solutions and aftermarket services to our global customers. For over 75 years, Rotoflow has designed and manufactured both standard and custom-engineered cryogenic and warm gas centrifugal turbomachinery used in market segments such as industrial gases, petrochemicals, and hydrocarbons. Products include our wide-ranging proprietary turbo-expanders and related equipment consisting of new equipment designs, upgrades and repairs along with a full complement of supporting services. Our customers are served globally through regional service centers supported by both regional and centralized execution teams.
We are currently seeking a Mechanical Designer to join our team at our global headquarters in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania. This role involves minimal travel.
Do you have a passion for precision design, solving unique engineering challenges, and contributing to world-class machinery development? Rotoflow is looking for a Mechanical Designer who thrives in a collaborative environment and is excited to work on high-speed rotating machinery and support systems. If this sounds like you, come grow with us as we continue to build a sustainable tomorrow together.
Rotoflow Employees Enjoy

  • Being part of a world class engineering, manufacturing, and business organization developing machinery solutions for our customers,
  • Collaborating with a multi-functional team across sales, engineering, purchasing, and manufacturing on a wide variety of projects with varying technical complexity and scope,
  • Tapping into the wealth of technical experience available within Rotoflow and the opportunity to explore technical interests,
  • Being part of a team of highly motivated individuals,
  • Seeing projects come to life from concept through manufacturing and testing,
  • The ability to grow and develop one’s career and take on increasing responsibility.
Key Job Responsibilities
  • Responsible for equipment design and development, layout, detailed part drawing creation, BOM generation, manufacturing, purchasing and production support as necessary throughout projects,
  • Creation of 3D CAD models of turbomachinery components including complex geometries such as radial impellers,
  • Creation of 2D and 3D CAD layouts,
  • Creation of 2D drawings using geometric dimensioning,
  • Perform stack-up analysis of precision machinery,
  • Interface with a broad spectrum of suppliers and disposition part variations and deviations,
  • Create conceptual layouts to support new product development,
  • Perform quality and technical checks of drawings and documents as a checker,
  • Designing and creating manufacturing drawings for tooling associated with servicing turbomachinery,
  • Creation, revision, and maintenance of part numbers, part routings and bills of materials in Air Products’ ERP system (SAP),
  • The successful candidate will need to interact with colleagues including proposals, project management, engineering, shop operations, and field service engineers,
  • Promote safety and diversity consistent with the philosophies of Rotoflow.
Required Skills / Abilities
  • 2D and 3D CAD, simulation, and FEA experience a plus,
  • Working knowledge of ERP and MRP Systems a plus,
  • Knowledge of turbomachinery or other high speed rotating machinery a strong plus,
  • Time management skills and ability to work independently on multiple concurrent projects or tasks and as a team,
  • Strong knowledge Microsoft Office tools,
  • Attention to detail and written and oral communication skills,
  • Understanding of revision control philosophy,
  • Experience with tolerancing and stack-up philosophies,
  • Experience with design of assembly tooling,
  • Experience with SolidWorks and Bentley MicroStation or AutoCAD a strong plus,
  • Experience with SAP ERP system a strong plus.
Minimum Hiring Requirements
  • Associates Degree in Mechanical Design or equivalent. BS in a technical field a plus,
  • Minimum 3 years' experience in a mechanical design occupation. 10+ years' experience a plus,
  • Basic knowledge of ANSI GD&T.
Working Conditions And/or Benefits Of This Role
  • This is a full-time position based in Bethlehem, PA,
  • You will be expected to work on-site 5 days per week during initial training. There is potential to transition to a hybrid work schedule,
  • Minimal travel required,
  • Opportunity for career growth and increasing responsibility,
  • Be part of a motivated, technically skilled team,
  • See your designs come to life from concept through manufacturing and testing.
If you are dedicated and driven to achieve your objectives and company goals, have passion and commitment to get it right, have a never-ending desire to learn, improve, and contribute, then come discover, care, accomplish and thrive at Air Products!
To learn more, visit Air Products and Rotoflow.
Air Products proudly values the skills, dedication, and leadership that veterans bring to the table. As a veteran-friendly organization, we actively encourage and welcome veterans to apply for various roles within our company. We recognize the unique strengths and experiences that veterans contribute, and we foster a workplace that honors your service while providing a platform for professional growth.
We are the world’s largest hydrogen producer with over 80 years of industrial gas experience. We are hydrogen and industrial gas experts delivering safe, end-to-end solutions, investing in real, clean energy projects at scale, and driving the industry forward to generate a cleaner future.
At Air Products, we work in an environment where we put safety first, diversity is essential, inclusion is our culture, and each person knows they belong and matter. To learn more, visitAbout Air Products.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package including paid holidays and vacation, affordable medical, dental, life insurance and retirement plans. You will be eligible for benefits and also be 100% vested in your retirement benefits on your first day of employment.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer (U.S.). You will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, citizenship, gender, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, or veteran status.
Air Products is committed to working with and providing a reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and you believe you need a reasonable accommodation to search for a job opening or to submit an online application, please e-mail us at General application status inquiries are not answered by this mailbox rather you’ll receive an e-mail directly from our Career Center and/or the Talent Acquisition Specialist.

Job Description
Associate & Counsel – J.P. Morgan Wealth Management/Consumer and Community Banking Legal department
Join JPMorgan Chase & Co., a leading global financial services firm, as an Associate & Counsel in our Wealth Management/Consumer and Community Banking Legal department. This role provides the opportunity to work closely with specific groups, offering legal services to the Corporation. As part of the J.P. Morgan Wealth Management Office of General Counsel, you'll contribute to our commitment to excellence in investment banking, financial services, and asset management.
Position Description
As an Associate Counsel in the J.P. Morgan Wealth Management Legal Team, you will be responsible for providing legal support to the firm's wealth management businesses. This includes handling escalations, conducting legal research, and assisting senior team members with various business requests and regulatory projects. You will also be involved in reviewing account documentation, drafting customer-facing communications, and working on special projects. This role requires excellent legal research skills, strong analytical thinking, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
The team is responsible for advising the firm’s client-facing wealth management business. Such legal support will primarily concern laws within the United States. The successful candidate will support the Firm’s Advisors, Sales Management, Operations, and Supervisory teams while working closely with colleagues on the The J.P. Morgan Wealth Management Legal team, Compliance, Controls and Risk to ensure comprehensive and effective support.
Job Responsibilities

  • Handle escalations sent to the JPM WM legal team, complete legal research, and assist senior team members with a wide range of business requests and regulatory projects.
  • Be organized, attentive to detail, exercise sound decision-making, and escalate issues when appropriate.
  • Thrive in a high-paced, deadline-promote organization, where timely execution of high-quality work product is expected.
  • Review account documentation, including powers of attorney, non-disclosure agreements, trust agreements, entity documents (e.g. corporate resolutions, by-laws, partnership agreements), court orders, guardianship documents, complex beneficiary changes, estate documentation (e.g., death certificates, wills), and retirement account documents.
  • Draft or edit certain customer facing communications.
  • Conduct legal and market research.
  • Identify potential issues and work with senior team members and appropriate business partners to provide solutions and Update account agreements, customer-facing documents, and disclosures, including reviewing legal requirements for new provisions.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills
  • Seeking bilingual candidates that are fluent in written and spoken English, with excellent English writing and oral communication skills.
  • Law degree and membership in jurisdictional organization. Attorney candidates must be in compliance with all relevant licensing requirements including the requirements of the jurisdiction where the role will be located prior to commencement of employment.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in legal practice.
  • Excellent legal research skills. A team player who can collaborate and communicate effectively with attorneys and other business and compliance professionals.
  • Strong analytical thinker who is detail-oriented, practical and skilled at issue spotting and problem solving.
  • Self-starter who is able to work independently, takes ownership of responsibilities and projects, is results-oriented and flexible.Ability to multitask and prioritize work in a fast-paced, complex business environment and maintain communication with attorneys regarding project status and estimated completion timelines.
  • All candidates for roles in the Legal department must successfully complete a conflicts of interest clearance review prior to commencement of employment.
Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills
  • LLM preferred.
  • Experience with Westlaw or similar services preferred.
  • Experience or interest in broker-dealer and investment advisory matters, including financial services regulation and/or financial services litigation.
  • Knowledge of U.S. financial service law and process.
  • Experience studying or working in a common law jurisdiction.
ABOUT US
J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world’s most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants’ and employees’ religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
About The Team
Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we’re setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.
With large, global operations, the Legal team tackles complex issues and helps shape the regulations that affect the businesses. The group is organized into practice groups that align with the lines of business and corporate staff areas, which encourages collaboration on legal, regulatory and business developments as they arise.

  4. Monitoring and Observability: Set up and maintain observability stacks using tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog. Monitor system health and performance, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
  5. Collaboration and Support: Collaborate with development and QA teams to ensure efficient application lifecycle management. Document processes, workflows, and playbooks for effective knowledge sharing.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Proven experience with Kubernetes in production environments, including deploying and scaling applications.
  • Strong expertise in Terraform and Terragrunt for IaC.

  • Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog.
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools (e.g., Helm) and secure application deployment practices.
  • Public Cloud provider certifications in AWS & or Kubernetes.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience with SRE practices and incident management workflows.
  • Proficiency in developing and deploying microservices, especially with Go (Golang).

description:
Job description

O que somos

A Galapagos Capital é umacompanhia de investimentos global, com soluções financeiras interconectadas para você, sua família e seu negócio.

Investment Banking, onde criamos soluções de crédito e M&A de forma flexível, simples e eficiente, adaptadas às necessidades de nossos clientes. É fácil fazer negócio com a gente!

Asset Management, onde nosso time de analistas seniores realiza análises contínuas e minuciosas do mercado adaptadas ao cenário econômico global, que norteiam as estratégias de investimentos para soluções financeiras mais assertivas aos portfólios dos nossos clientes. Aliando performance com resiliência!

Wealth Management , onde promovemos o acesso mais transparente e eficiente ao mercado de capitais, aprimorando a forma de fazer banking, através da criação de produtos exclusivos e da expertise de profissionais com mais de 30 anos de mercado em gestão de patrimônio e riscos. Evoluímos o seu jeito de investir!

Nossa missão

Acreditamos nopoder transformadordo mercado financeiro que une, de forma eficiente, quem precisa de crédito e quem tem capital para investir. Num mercado bastante concentrado e dominado por grandes bancos, como o brasileiro, o potencial para essa transformação é imenso. A Galapagos Capital quer liderar esse processo. Adotamos um jeito disruptivo de fazer banking: sem agências e sem a utilização de balanço.

Por serinovadora, leve e criativa , a Galapagos reúne a capacidade de originar, estruturar e alocar operações de crédito de maneira que nossos clientes possam usufruir desses rendimentos de forma rentável e com pouca volatilidade. Desse jeito, ajudamos empresas e pessoas a terem acesso a crédito de forma competitiva e transformamos esses créditos em soluções de investimento -tudo dentro de casa.

A evolução na forma de fazer Banking - Somos mais eficientes, mais ágeis e, principalmente, oferecemos resultados muito melhores para nossos clientes. É para isso que a Galapagos nasceu: para ajudar o mercado financeiro a evoluir, alcançando seu potencial e beneficiando milhões de brasileiros.

Saiba mais sobre a Galapagos:


Main responsibilities

Atuação em todas as fases das atividades de DCM (análise de oportunidades de crédito, estruturação de dívidas e assessoramento em ofertas públicas, entre outros). Oportunidade de trabalhar como parte de times em projetos estratégicas, proporcionando exposição significativa, tanto internamente quanto a clientes e contrapartes.

No seu dia a dia?

  • Execução de análises quantitativas e qualitativas, relativas a mercados, empresas, bases de dados, etc. com viés de análise de crédito;
  • Análise das demonstrações financeiras (Balanço Patrimonial, Demonstração de Resultados, Fluxo de Caixa, etc.);
  • Análise de empresas comparáveis (múltiplos de avaliação, índices financeiros, etc.);
  • Desenvolvimento de modelos financeiros (projeções de negócios; valuation);
  • Preparação de apresentações em PowerPoint (teasers, info memos, pitch books, materiais para discussão em comitê de crédito, etc.);
  • Apoio na condução dos processos de due-diligence jurídica e financeira e revisão de contratos das transações de DCM;
  • Apoio na elaboração de estruturas de transações de DCM, cobrindo soluções de dívidas lastro, garantias e atendimento da regulamentação aplicável;
  • Orientação e coordenação ao trabalho dos estagiários.

Requirements and skills

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência prévia em DCM ou análise de crédito estruturado;
  • Formação preferencialmente em Engenharia, Economia, Administração de Empresas ou Direito (desde que possua base concreta de finanças corporativas);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de contabilidade, finanças corporativas e visão de negócios;
  • Raciocínio analítico, habilidades de resolução de problemas, capacidade de trabalhar com números e forte atenção aos detalhes;
  • Proficiência em Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Comunicação verbal/escrita objetiva e precisa;
  • Inglês fluente.

2.2. Estabelece foco na condução profissional das suas atividades.
2.3. Monitora o andamento da realização do plano de ação, visando à revisão de estratégias em tempo hábil.

2.8. Sistematiza processo de autoavaliação dos estudantes.
2.9 .Realiza projetos, junto aos estudantes, a partir de uma visão integradora dos segmentos.

2.10. Registra os processos sob sua responsabilidade.

2.11. Acompanha o desenvolvimento da aquisição das habilidades cognitivas dos estudantes, incentivando-os na construção dos hábitos de estudos.
2.12. Monitora criteriosamente o trabalho dos Auxiliares de Disciplina.
2.13. Zela pelo cumprimento dos códigos de disciplina e ética dentro da escola.

Administrar e aplicar vacinas adequadamente, de acordo com a técnica correta e registrar na shift.

Conhecer a visão e a missão da empresa.

Cumprir normas regulamentadas da empresa e da sua área de atuação.

Zelar pela ética e disciplina na empresa.

Utilizar práticas do 5 S.

Executar outras tarefas correlatas às acima descritas, a critério de seu superior imediato.

Estamos em busca de um Repórter talentoso, com experiência consolidada em coberturas jornalísticas de impacto, para integrar nossa equipe. Queremos alguém que vá além dos fatos, que saiba apurar, produzir e conduzir reportagens envolventes, tocando o público e gerando valor para a sociedade.

  • Criativo e inovador – Encontra novas formas de contar histórias e prender a atenção do público;
  • Comprometido com a ética e a verdade – Acredita no poder do jornalismo para transformar a realidade.

Se esse perfil tem a sua cara, vem fazer parte do time da RPC de Foz do Iguaçu!

Responsibilities and assignments

Conheça o Dia a Dia Desse Profissional

  • Produzir reportagens de acordo com os nossos atributos e princípios jurídicos e editoriais da RPC e da GLOBO. Conhecer, aplicar e disseminar internamente as normas, condutas e políticas do GRPCOM;
  • Sugerir assuntos relevantes e buscar personagens que auxiliem na narrativa dos fatos para o público;
  • Construir e manter uma rede sólida de fontes para acesso a informações estratégicas e exclusivas, garantindo diferenciação nas coberturas jornalísticas;
  • Redigir e falar de forma clara e cativante, integrando texto com imagens e artes para complementar e enriquecer a reportagem;

  • Ampla cultura geral, mantendo-se constantemente atualizado através da leitura para expandir sua visão de mundo. Utilizar diferentes perspectivas para o desenvolvimento de um pensamento crítico e análise contextualizada;
  • Zelar pela imagem pessoal e profissional, mantendo conduta ética e alinhada aos valores da empresa tanto dentro quanto fora do ambiente corporativo;
  • Manter visual adequado, conforme orientações da área responsável, e cuidar da voz, realizando sessões de fonoaudiologia e praticando os exercícios recomendados regularmente.

Requirements And Qualifications

O que você precisa ter:

  • Graduação completa em Jornalismo, desejável pós-graduação na área;
  • DRT/MTB (Registro profissional de jornalista);
  • Domínio da Língua Portuguesa, com conhecimento desejável de pelo menos um idioma adicional (preferencialmente o inglês), e domínio de informática em nível de usuário;
  • Vivência sólida em campo como Repórter;
  • Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de textos, produção de vídeos e reportagens completas;
  • Experiência em levantamento e desenvolvimento de pautas, cultivo e manutenção de fontes, além de possuir um bom relacionamento com jornalistas e fontes externas;

About The Company
If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.
We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).
To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.
Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.
About The Team/role
We focus on understanding the dynamics of our clients, enhancing user experience, and coordinating delivery services to ensure seamless operations. With a results-driven mindset and a strong emphasis on cross-functional collaboration, the team drives merchant growth and engagement, refines the user journey, and works closely with delivery partners to improve service quality. We don’t just operate — we manage and grow the local market with precision and purpose.
In this role, you'll be...

  • Develop and implement user growth strategies for the food delivery business, leveraging tools such as pricing optimization and promotional activities (e.g., new user incentives, free delivery policies) to enhance new customer acquisition and retention. Monitor key metrics (e.g., new users volume, retention rate, and frequency) and adjust strategies accordingly.
  • Collaborate with the Product team to optimize growth-related product features and traffic entries through competitor research, user feedback, and data analysis. Explore and drive new product capabilities to continuously innovate user growth strategies.
  • Work cross-functionally with Commercial, Marketing, Product, and Operations teams to ensure effective communication and implementation of promotions and campaigns. Design and implement in-app comms plan, utilizing resources such as banners, pop-up, pushes, etc.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...
  • Bachelor's degree or above, with at least 5 years of work experience, including 2+ years in growth or user operations in tech companies. Experience in the food service, consumer goods or retail industry is a plus.
  • Familiarity with local market trends, holidays, and peak seasons; data sensitive, result-oriented and execution-driven.
  • Demonstrated ability to think creatively and strategically, while also being data-driven in decision-making.
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate with stakeholders with diverse backgrounds at all levels.
  • Passion for the food service industry and understanding the consumer journey.
  • Highly energetic, self-motivated and proactive.Organized and structured, ability to identify business needs.

You'll love working at DiDi because...
We create user value
We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.
We are data-driven
We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
Win-win Collaboration
Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
We believe in integrity
Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
Growth
We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
Diversity and Inclusion
Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.
Diversity & Inclusion
Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.
We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.
We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

Job Description
TÉCNICO(A) MANUTENÇÃO MECÂNICA III (HIDRÁULICA)
ÁREA: SECAGEM
Local: Ribas do Rio Pardo/MS
Inscrições até 01/06/2025
QUEM SOMOS?
Prazer, somos a Suzano!
Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas. Cultivamos a vida na folha do caderno que alfabetiza as crianças, na fralda que protege os bebês, no copo de café que não prejudica o meio ambiente, em papéis absorventes e na comodidade do uso de uma embalagem sustentável.
PLURAL
Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Aqui você pode descobrir novos desafios, novos horizontes, novos objetivos e até mais sobre si mesmo!
Responsibilities and assignments
O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

  • Registrar histórico e apropriar horas trabalhadas nas ordens executadas de manutenção no sistema informatizado de manutenção (SAP-PM);
  • Participar e incentivar a participação nos programas corporativo e da unidade;
  • Abrir notas de manutenção para os desvios identificados na área industrial;
  • Participar da rotina de gestão da área;
  • Propor melhorias para garantir o perfeito funcionamento e produtividade dos equipamentos;
  • Realizar rotas de inspeção, reportando e fazendo parte da tratativa de solução de eventuais anomalias nos equipamentos;
  • Operação com equipamentos de guindar (Pontes rolante, talhas elétricas e manuais).
  • Operação com e Plataforma elevatória e Empilhadeira.
  • Elaborar, cumprir e fomentar procedimentos de manutenção e segurança;
  • Participar de análises de falhas junto a confiabilidade.
  • Ter conhecimento de desenho e metrologia mecânica, hidráulica e pneumática.
  • Ter domínio inclusive como multiplicador em hidráulica, pneumático e lubrificação.
  • Executar trabalhos de alinhamento de conjuntos rotativos.
  • Atuar com ênfase em sistemas hidráulicos, focando as preventivas, preditivas e corretivas.
  • Elaborar com suporte da engenharia análises de falhas e melhorias nos equipamentos.
  • Suportar gestão na condução técnica das atividades.
  • Elaborar e conhecer desenhos de componentes de equipamentos hidráulicos, pneumáticos e mecânicos.
Requirements And Qualifications
QUEM NOS INSPIRA?
  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.
O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?
  • Ensino técnico completo
  • CRT ativo
  • Conhecimento específico na disciplina de hidráulica e pneumática industrial;
  • Conhecimento em Secadora celulose, atuação em prensas de enfardamentos, shoe press (prensas sapatas), UH´s (Unidades hidráulicas),
  • Conhecimento em Linha de Fibras, Raspador de fundo do digestor, UH´s;
  • Leitura / interpretação de fluxogramas e malhas hidráulicas, diagnósticos de falhas provenientes sistemas hidráulicos.
  • Disponibilidade de residir em Ribas do Rio Pardo/MS
Additional information
NÓS TEMOS MUITO MAIS QUE UM PAPEL NA SUA VIDA!
Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida;
VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;
Sabemos que a renda fixa é importante, mas, além disso, oferecemos uma renda extra por meio do nosso Programa de Remuneração Variável (Anual);
Para você se preparar para o futuro temos a Previdência privada;
Para gerar e compartilhar valor disponibilizamos cursos e treinamentos E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, o UniverSuzano;
Na Suzano, só é bom para nós se for bom para o mundo! Por isso, durante o ano realizamos muitas ações legais e você poderá se tornar um voluntário do nosso programa Voluntariar;
Também contamos com um Clube de Descontos, com diversos parceiros, para você aproveitar!
PARA A FAMÍLIA
Como empresa cidadã, entendemos a importância da chegada de uma criança. Por isso, oferecemos extensão da licença paternidade para 20 dias e maternidade para 180 dias. O benefício também vale para papais e mamães que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homo afetivos;
Para as mamães retornarem tranquilas ao trabalho, oferecemos um auxílio creche bem bacana.
Pensando em oferecer sempre as melhores condições para nosso time e suas família, disponibilizamos um auxílio mensal em dinheiro que se aplica ao pai ou mãe que tiver sob sua guarda filho ou filha com alguma necessidade especial;
Aqui seus filhos e filhos não ficam de fora, oferecemos um vale brinquedo e um kit material escolar recheado! E, se no final do ano os filhos mandarem bem na escola, reconheceremos o seu esforço por meio do nosso programa Estudar é Crescer, com um prêmio em dinheiro que poderão usar como preferir.
SUZANO FAZ BEM
O Faz Bem tem um cuidado especial para você, colaborador(a) e sua família, confira baixo:
  • Tele Faz Bem: Atendimento gratuito e confidencial ao colaborador(a) Suzano e seus(as) dependentes(as) nas seguintes frentes: Apoio psicológico e de assistência social, orientação jurídica, financeira, de atividade física e nutricional;
  • Plataforma de saúde mental – A Wellz, oferece sessões de terapia online subsidiadas pela Suzano de forma confidencial, além de várias oportunidades de auto cuidado como jornadas, diário de humor, terapia em grupo, entre outros;
  • Plataforma de saúde física – A Wellhub é uma plataforma completa de bem estar com acesso a academias, aplicativos e aulas on-line com liberdade de escolha de atividades.
  • Programa de gestantes – O programa “Bebê Saudável” realiza o acompanhamento gestacional através de contato telefônico e abordagens, além do recebimento de um kit personalizado.

MUITO PRAZER, NÓS SOMOS A SUZANO!
Somos uma empresa multinacional brasileira, referência global no desenvolvimento de soluções sustentáveis e inovadoras , de origem renovável, por meio do plantio de árvores de eucalipto. E elas estão no centro do nosso propósito, que é o de “renovar a vida a partir da árvore”. É assim que nós plantamos um futuro mais sustentável para o planeta e para as pessoas .
Temos 100 anos de vida, e hoje, somos a maior fabricante de celulose do mundo e uma das maiores produtoras de papéis da América Latina . Nossos produtos atendem mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do planeta e nós exportamos para mais de 100 países. Quanto às unidades, entre administrativas e operacionais, estamos presentes também internacionalmente na Argentina, Áustria, Canadá, China, Estados Unidos, Finlândia, Israel e Suíça.
E, tudo isso só é possível por causa das pessoas da Suzano: somos a soma de cerca de 20 mil colaboradores(as) próprios(as) e mais de 20 mil terceiros e terceiras, além de 300 colaboradores(as) em nossos escritórios internacionais .
